meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你规划 FluidSim 流体力学模拟:挑选合适的求解器、设置网格与物理参数、配置 FFT/MPI 并行;模拟结束后会查看和绘制速度、涡量等结果,也会检查设置是否有效、能否续跑。
howto.when: 当你要运行流体力学模拟(如 Navier-Stokes、浅水、分层流等),或需要选求解器、检查参数、配置 FFT/MPI 等时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 我想用 FluidSim 模拟 2D 湍流,帮我配置一下参数。
say.note: Claude 会给出 ns2d 求解器的参数配置。

say.text: 帮我分析刚才那次模拟的涡量场和能谱。
say.note: Claude 会加载保存的输出并绘出涡量与能谱图。

say.text: 我想接着上次的结果继续跑,怎么重启模拟?
say.note: Claude 会检查已有数据并给出续跑方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help plan FluidSim CFD runs: pick the proper solver, set grid and physical parameters, configure FFT/MPI; plot velocity/vorticity fields afterward, and check validity or restart compatibility.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to run fluid simulations (Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flows, etc.) or needs solver selection, parameter review, or FFT/MPI setup.

say_en.text: I want to simulate 2D turbulence with FluidSim; help me set up the parameters.
say_en.note: Claude will give you the ns2d parameter setup.

say_en.text: Analyze the vorticity field and energy spectra from my last simulation.
say_en.note: Claude loads the output and plots vorticity and spectra.

say_en.text: I want to resume my previous simulation from the saved data; how do I restart?
say_en.note: Claude will check saved outputs and give restart steps.
